findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards log state
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext returns NewTestLogger() instead of itself. LoggerMiddleware now logs via m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so calls made through the middleware are recorded on a fresh discarded instance, not on the injected fake. Tests asserting InfoLogs.Calls/Message on the original fake will see zero calls and cannot verify pluginId/endpoint/error logging.

findings.title: Adding FromContext breaks Logger implementers
findings.body: The Logger interface gains a new required method FromContext(ctx context.Context) Logger. Any existing out-of-tree implementation of plugins/log.Logger will fail to compile after this change. This is a breaking interface change done as a chore/rename with no deprecation or adapter.

findings.title: Plugin request logs lose traceID and identifying fields
findings.body: LoggerMiddleware.logRequest previously logged pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName, dsUID and traceID (via tracing.TraceIDFromContext) explicitly. The new version only logs status, duration, eventName and time_before_plugin_request and relies on m.logger.FromContext(ctx). The new ContextualLoggerMiddleware.instrumentContext only adds endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, uname and never adds traceID, so the traceID correlation and any fields when the contextual middleware is absent or ordered differently are permanently lost from 'Plugin Request Completed' logs.

findings.title: Streaming endpoints skip contextual logger
findings.body: QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth and CollectMetrics wrap the context with instrumentContext, but SubscribeStream, PublishStream and RunStream just forward ctx unchanged. Those streaming requests therefore never get endpoint/pluginId/ds/uname contextual attributes, so downstream logging via FromContext for streams is inconsistent with the other endpoints even though those request types also carry a PluginContext.
